# Timeline Studio

> A planning tool whose dates are computed rather than entered. You describe the work,
> how long each piece takes and what must precede what; the scheduler answers when it
> lands. A plan is one shared document and every change is a command.

**The token in the share link — the part after `#` — is the whole credential.** Never put
it in a URL, a log line, or a commit. Repeated here rather than left to the reference
below because it is the one mistake that cannot be undone.

Read **[/AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md)**. It is the whole reference, and it indexes everything
else — the OpenAPI spec, the command vocabulary, the scheduler.

This file used to list those itself. Two indexes is two copies, and the one nobody
maintains is the one that goes on naming a file after it has been renamed — a lying index
is worse than no index. So there is one, it lives in the reference, and this points at it.
